title: Juice N Power Bar Salts Blue Sour Raspberry 10ml E-Liquid
description: Blue Sour Raspberry from the JNP Bar Salts collection delivers a sharp, vibrant, and deeply engaging fruit profile. The bold, syrupy sweetness of rich Blue Raspberry lays down a robust foundation, which is immediately followed by a sharp and acidic sour tang. This contrasting combination creates a dynamic and highly vivid flavour journey that remains consistently satisfying. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid nicotine relief and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. These extra-concentrated e-liquids are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. Formulated by the UK brand Juice N Power, the JNP Bar Salts collection takes inspiration from popular bar-style blends to deliver intense, long-lasting flavour in a versatile 10ml format. Offering a comprehensive range of fruit, soda, and confectionery profiles alongside unique mixes, there is a dependable option for every preference. Beyond the sharp bite of Blue Sour Raspberry, vapers can explore other compelling profiles such as the complex Mr. Blue or the classic Banana Ice.
